properties.description: Pins the class of fact:a-release-server-overflows-its-2-mib-worker-stack-on-a-reasoning-chain-about-2000-steps-deep-and-the-whole-process-aborts-2026-10-25. (1) foundations_walk and proof_chain_walk on a chain 100,000 steps deep on a thread with an explicit 2 MiB stack (crates/reflow2-core/src/inference/deep_walks.rs). (2) get_node and loop_status through the server's request path on a 2 MiB runtime worker, on a chain 1,000 steps deep (debug) or 3,000 (release) (crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_deep_reasoning_chain_is_answered_on_a_2_mib_worker.rs). The deep cases run in a child process each, since an overflow aborts the program. (3) Equivalence: each walk against the recursion it replaced, state for state, on every fixture and 200 generated designs.
properties.findings: FAILED FIRST, watched on ajs77 against main's walks (0c567349c's inference.rs, everything else as on the branch): in debug and in release, both 100,000-step walk tests aborted in the child ("thread 'deep-walk' has overflowed its stack", SIGABRT), and get_node and loop_status end to end aborted ("thread 'tokio-rt-worker' has overflowed its stack", SIGABRT) at 1,000 steps (debug) and 3,000 and 5,000 (release). The equivalence tests passed there, as they must. PASSING on the branch: all six, debug (walks 25.8 s, end to end 35.3 s) and release (walks 4.8 s, end to end 68.6 s at 3,000). Mutation check: reversing the premise order in the new foundations walk, or dropping the unconfirmed-step mark in the new proof walk, failed the equivalence tests. Whole suites without RocksDB: reflow2-mcp all passed; reflow2-core 2,097 passed, 2 failed, both fixed or environmental (edge_readers.yaml listing for the test helpers, added; a round-trip test that needs docs/design, absent from the remote copy).
properties.name: Deep reasoning chains on a 2 MiB stack: the walks at 100,000 steps, get_node and loop_status end to end
